description: What the main window may do: drag itself by the title bar, show a path selected in Finder (the file manager elsewhere) through the opener plugin, open a file in the library or agentx home with the system's default application through the same plugin, open an https page such as a source's repository in the default browser through the same plugin, and let the user pick a file to import in the native open dialog of the dialog plugin, which returns the path and reads nothing; it may not open any other URL, open a file with a named application through the plugin, save, or read or write a file itself.
